crossref.title: Newly developed flexible endoscopic scissors for removal of a nasogastric tube trapped within a gastrojejunal anastomotic staple line

openalex.title: Newly developed flexible endoscopic scissors for removal of a nasogastric tube trapped within a gastrojejunal anastomotic staple line
openalex.abstract: A 72-year-old woman underwent a laparorobotic pancreaticoduodenectomy using the da Vinci Surgical System (Intuitive Surgical Inc., Sunnyvale, California, USA) for removal of a 4-cm ampullary adenoma. Intraoperatively, a nasogastric tube was inserted into the gastric fundus and its proximal end was secured to the patient’s nares. On postoperative day 2, the tube could not be removed at the bedside.
